descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S04 「现成 spec：provider 行和失败的种类决定走哪条路——默认 Haiku、行里选的主模型、临时 / 被拒 / 没分类 / 部署错误、回退之后保持（S25 并到这里）」 Existing specs: the provider row and the kind of failure decide the path — Haiku default, row-picked primary, temporary / refused / unclassified / deployment, sticky fallback (S25 merged here)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 A Haiku failure that is not temporary skips the Haiku retry and goes straight to Mistral（TFA-94422 AC 3）
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral（UAT OAT-03 step 6；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3；TFA-94422 AC 2）
  • T4 The default model is Haiku, set in the 'AI provider' table and changeable without a new release（TFA-94422 AC 1；UAT 3.1）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given chat() with bedrock.invoke stubbed: Haiku fails with ThrottlingException 429 (temporary), ValidationException 400 (refused), a plain unclassified Error, or AccessDeniedException 403 (deployment); providers.spec.ts defaults and chat() with row variants

When Ask once per row; resolve the default; run with the row's model = Mistral (no fallback, and with a Haiku fallback); run two calls in one operation after a fallback; start a new invocation

Then Temporary: Haiku once more, then Mistral. Refused: Mistral at once, no second Haiku try. Unclassified: Mistral at once. Deployment: thrown at once, no retry and no fallback. Row: default text generation is Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5; the row's model is the primary; inside one operation the fallback is kept for later calls; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions on call order. Rows 1–3 are TFA-94422 AC 2 / AC 3. Row 4 (thrown, no Mistral) is the AC 3 exception from self-review item C: recorded, not judged until Q5 is answered. 'Changeable without a new release' is shown by the row tests, not by changing a deployed row (aiProvider:_set is forbidden here); …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
